title: Default Model Configuration
subtitle: Configure AI models for different scenarios

image_understanding.label: Image Understanding
image_understanding.description: Analyze images and screenshots, support mixed image-text conversations

speech_recognition.label: Speech Recognition
speech_recognition.description: Convert speech to text, support voice input

modeOverrides.title: Mode Model Overrides
modeOverrides.description: Specify different models for specific modes (default: primary model)

subAgentOverrides.title: SubAgent Model Overrides
subAgentOverrides.description: Specify different models for specific assistants (default: primary model)

selection.notConfigured: Not configured, will use the current model

empty.noModels: No models available. Please add models in the "Model List" tab first.

smartRouter.sectionDescription: Assign models automatically by request complexity
smartRouter.title: Enable smart routing
smartRouter.description: When the session model is "Auto", a local RWKV model classifies request complexity and routes to the matching tier model

r0.label: R0 Trivial chat
r0.description: Greetings, thanks, short acknowledgments — lightest model

r1.label: R1 Simple task
r1.description: Single-step operations, simple Q&A, translation, lookup

r2.label: R2 Complex task
r2.description: Code generation, multi-step reasoning, multi-tool orchestration

r3.label: R3 High-stakes task
r3.description: Debugging, error diagnosis, long context, critical changes

fallback.label: Fallback model
fallback.description: Used when classification fails or the local engine is unavailable

status.loaded: Classification head loaded ({{dim}}-d), smart routing active
status.notLoaded: Classification head not loaded: {{reason}} (smart routing falls back)

test.title: Test classification
test.placeholder: Type any request to see which tier it routes to…

warnings.invalidRef: Some tiers reference a missing or disabled model; they will fall back to primary at runtime

safetyThreshold.label: Safety upgrade threshold
safetyThreshold.description: Upgrade to R2 when predicted R0/R1 but P(R2)+P(R3) exceeds this value (prefer over-routing)

sticky.label: Sticky tier
sticky.description: Short messages never route below the previous turn's tier within a session

timeout.label: Classification timeout
timeout.description: Max wait for local-model classification before falling back

smartRouter.hint: Three tiers: R0/R1 → RWKV local, R2 → complex-task model, R3 → hard-task model; classification extracts features with the local RWKV model and scores them with the trained head (router_head.json), falling back automatically when unavailable
